knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The therapist's safety comes first. The therapist stops, leaves if safe, escalates and records the incident.
A firm, level table with a clear path and heater cords kept away from the table is the safe set-up.
The lesson says a self-employed person's work must not expose others to risk, within what is reasonably practicable.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate complete the arrival check-in and the departure check-out with the lone-worker method, and record the times
Assessor observes the candidate inspect a simulated room, identify at least two trip or heat hazards, and make the room safe before the session
Assessor presents a simulated threat and observes the candidate stop, leave if safe, escalate and record
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Check-in and check-out times for the simulated visit
Room set-up checklist for the simulated visit
Incident record for the simulated threat
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate starts a session in a room with an unresolved trip or heat hazard
The candidate stays with a client after a threat appears
The candidate enters a home without confirming the address and access details
